# prismasdwan_wan_interface_label (Resource)

Manages a Prisma SD-WAN Wan Interface Label.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Palo Alto Networks Inc. 2025
#
# Sample resource example for "wan_interface_label".
# This file is generated - do not edit by hand.
#
# Before using this example, configure the Prisma SD-WAN provider:
#
#   terraform {
#     required_providers {
#       prismasdwan = {
#         source  = "paloaltonetworks/prismasdwan"
#       }
#     }
#   }
#
#   provider "prismasdwan" {
#     host          = "api.sase.paloaltonetworks.com"
#     client_id     = "acmeuser@12345.iam.panserviceaccount.com"
#     client_secret = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
#     scope         = "tsg_id:12345"
#     auth_url      = "https://auth.apps.paloaltonetworks.com/am/oauth2/access_token"
#   }

resource "prismasdwan_wan_interface_label" "example" {
  app_acceleration_enabled = false
  bwc_enabled              = false
  description              = "Managed by Terraform"
  l3_reachability = {
    probe_config_ids    = ["<probe_config_id>"]
    use_element_default = false
  }
  label                                   = "public-1"
  lqm_enabled                             = false
  name                                    = "example_name"
  probe_profile_id                        = "<probe_profile_id>"
  tags                                    = ["terraform"]
  use_for_application_reachability_probes = false
  use_for_controller_connections          = false
  use_lqm_for_non_hub_paths               = false
  vpnlink_configuration = {
    keep_alive_failure_count = 3
    keep_alive_interval      = 100
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `app_acceleration_enabled` (Boolean) App acceleration enabled.
- `bwc_enabled` (Boolean) Bwc enabled.
- `l3_reachability` (Attributes) L3 reachability. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--l3_reachability))
- `label` (String) Label. Value: matching `(public|private)-(([1-9])|([1-2][0-9])|(3[0-2])|(100[0-9]))`.
- `lqm_enabled` (Boolean) Lqm enabled.
- `name` (String) Name. Value: at most 128 characters.
- `use_for_application_reachability_probes` (Boolean) Use for application reachability probes.
- `use_for_controller_connections` (Boolean) Use for controller connections.
- `use_lqm_for_non_hub_paths` (Boolean) Use lqm for non hub paths.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Value: at most 256 characters.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the object, assigned by the API. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `probe_profile_id` (String) Probe profile id.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags. At most 10 items. Each item: at most 128 characters, matching `[^,\s]+`.
- `vpnlink_configuration` (Attributes) Vpnlink configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpnlink_configuration))
- `x_etag` (Number) Etag for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `x_parameters` (Map of String) Path parameters for the resource, managed automatically by the provider.
- `x_schema` (Number) Schema version for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.

### Read-Only

- `tfid` (String) The Terraform internal identifier for this resource.
